summary: The Pulse room keeps a message the dialogue coordinator marks retryable (no model reached while Samantha restarts, or a closed maintenance window) and submits the same event again every 5 s for at most 5 min, then answers normally; past that bound it says Samantha is still restarting and that nothing ran, instead of « … n'a pas abouti. Aucun nouvel essai automatique n'est lancé. ».
reason: Amine 28/10 (« oui, à traiter après redémarrage », replaces D-B of ADR 57). S24 28/10 16:05: Sadok's message arrived while the Gateway restarted after the core deploy; both interpretation attempts were « unavailable » within 54-62 ms and the room answered with a final failure; the Companion was ready 14 s later. OpenClaw 2026.9.6 applies no default timeout to a claiming before_dispatch hook (hooks-CKanWLsK.mjs, getClaimingHookTimeoutMs uses the hook's own timeoutMs only), so the wait cannot hand the message to the general model.

tests.name: openclaw-plugin-mobile-ui/scripts/test-pulse-room-fast-path.cjs
tests.evidence: New: a retryable turn is submitted again with the same event and answers once ready; a window that never reopens ends on the « redémarre encore » text; a final failure is never submitted again. Fails on the base (DEFER_UNTIL_READY undefined).

architecture.reason: Same hook, same coordinator event; the decision record (ADR-20261028-defer-until-ready) lives with the coordinator in samantha-ui-playbooks.

evidence: Pulse room hook only; MCP primitives unchanged.

limitations: Requires the coordinator of samantha-ui-playbooks (same day) to mark these turns retryable; before it, nothing changes.
Owner WhatsApp and app turns keep their current behaviour during a restart.
Full canonical CI on the final GitHub head remains required.
Live proof: a Pulse room message sent during a core deploy is answered once Samantha is ready.
rollback: Revert this commit and redeploy with companion-deploy.sh.
